name: Kitezh
note: Fictional post-Soviet civil-law republic. Exists only as synthetic test material: a codified Soviet-successor legal system publishing in Russian (Cyrillic script), used to exercise the Razdel/Glava/Statya/chast hierarchy and amendment/citation tracking without shipping any real jurisdiction's law in the open test tree. Not a real place; carries no real legislation.

act.label: Закон
act.note: Standard codified statute. Razdel (title) and Glava (chapter) are higher divisions; Statya (article) is the basic citable unit numbered continuously through the whole Law. Chast (paragraph) and punkt (point) are the subdivisions within an article.

frbr.note: Laws identified by calendar year and law number, e.g. Law No. 12 of 1994.

numbering.note: Laws cited by short title (e.g. 'Закон о нормативных правовых актах') or by number and year. Inserted articles carry a hyphen suffix, e.g. статья 18-1 after статья 18.

enacting_formulae.text: Настоящий Закон принят Собранием Китежа и промульгирован в соответствии с Основным Законом Республики Китеж.

amendments.phrasing: изложить в следующей редакции... дополнить статьёй... признать утратившей силу...

structuring.prompt_additions: Body-fill task only. Preserve citations, inline markup, and list numbering verbatim. Never emit structural keywords; the scaffold owns hierarchy.

validation.note: Synthetic reference jurisdiction. Three Bluebell-authored laws round-trip through parse_to_akn to schema-valid, zero-advisory-error AKN (experiments/synthetic_scans).
